## Summary

```text
UpgradePanel
  imported root1935 geometry → native symbols / mock paths
  source field metrics and weapon summaries
  retained animated previews → original 158×84 initial fit
  separate card and Edit hit regions
```

Layer 3 of the five-PR batch, based on #126. Replaces approximate upgrade cards with authored placements, fields and fitted live artwork. Numerical data regenerates from the player's research SWF; media remains unbundled. Allows follow-up layers to be built during earlier CI, up to five in flight.

## Evidence

- **Before:** approximate CSS layout, generic previews and a weapon panel outside the choose hit region.
  **After:** source card positions, compound panel contours, independent Edit controls, source summaries (including retained trailing comma), and stage-driven preview animation.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 837 unit tests / 7,808 assertions passed.
- Six affected mock/supplied-file browser cases passed without skips; the final two presentation cases passed again after the mock text adjustment. Production build passed. Screenshots inspected.
- Upgrade data regenerates byte-identically; shared field decoder leaves tank-viewer data unchanged.
- Restored level-two history is an explicit fixture. Bitmap capture/blur, retained menu timing and complete original/Adobe/game parity remain open for following layers.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** upgrade

Changes upgrade rendering, text and hit regions. Simulation offer selection is unchanged. Hold master until five layers pass exact-head Actions/review gates and the assembled bottom branch is validated. Intermediate `stack/**` previews are intentionally disabled; hosted Actions is still required.
